predictions: Wow, another 18-7 week. That's my fifth 18-7 week of the season, and my third in a row. And not only that, but it's the usual suspects making my picks look bad… Off Constantly, McGavin, Ton 80 Proof, Bangin the Wire… even Reload and the Rangers and Corks… It's crazy how there are just some times that keep me confused for extended periods. At least I can take solace in the fact that 6 of my 7 wrong would have flipped or tied on a single dart, as usual. Up to 213-86 for the season.

Match of the week: (D Div.) Red-eye Rangers @ Reload. All of a sudden, the D race is again a four-team free-for-all. Sadly, this is the last pairing between two of those four contenders, but that at least means that this is the most important remaining D match this season. These teams have each somehow lost 2 of their last 3, but Reload is somehow still in the D race driver seat. I'll go with Reload, 13-11.

Match #2: (G Div.) Bottoms Up @ That's What She Said. She Said still sits atop the G standings, but if they want to be there when it's all said and done, they are going to have to earn it. Their last two matches are against the two teams trying to reel them in. In addition, those two teams' other remaining match is against one of the bottom three teams, so they could certainly close the point gap. This story is sooo much better if Bottoms Up wins this, so let's take the Bottoms Upset, 13-11.

Match #3: (E Div.) Liquor Possee @ Cheap Shots. Possee's week 11 win over Dart Side has set them up for clinching this title and rolling on up to D next season. All they have to do is win just one more (and might not even need that). Taking down the Cheapies won't be easy (Cheapies have won 4 of the last 5), but I'll ride with the Possee, 14-10.

Matches #4 & #5: (C Div.) Hump Day! @ Darty Sanchez; The Outlaws @ Off Constantly-Reboot. The 2nd through 5th C teams are separated by one win each spot, so with only two weeks left it's clear that some of them really aren't title competitors anymore. But the 4th place Outlaws have won two in a row, and 5th place Sanchez has won three in a row, so these outcomes are anything but pre-determined. Will those two end the chances of their opponents tonight? Barely no, and yes! The Humpers narrowly escape, 13-11; but The Outlaws get their upset, 14-10.

Match #6: (G Div.) Dart Vader's @ We're Sexy & We Throw It. With She Said facing the Bottoms tonight, the Vader's don't really even need She Said to lose. They just need to get their own win, gain some points, and get within range for their week 14 She Said showdown that is likely for the G crown. Vader's gets payback, 15-9.

Match #7: (B Div.) Raging Bulls Eyes @ Nine Lives. Ok, we're getting to that point where we will be deciding who is likely to drop a division next season. And here we have what might well be a direct head-to-head to determine one of those spots. Raging, 13-11.

Match #8: (F Div.) Shark Shooters @ Zero Dart Ton 80. With Rippin facing Zero Dart next week (and the Shooters facing the last place team), if the Shooters can pull the upset here, they still have a slim shot at a top-two finish. Alas, Zero is not to be stopped, 16-8.

Matches #9 & #10: (A Div.) Element XL @ 2 Liver Die with LA; The Bullies @ Lunatic Fringe. Second half of the pre-showdown testers for Element and Bullies. Won't be a whole lot of drama in the wk14 showdown this season unless Element falls tonight and the Bullies don't. Obviously, I'm kinda hoping that doesn't happen. I'm thinking both take care of business. Element & Bullies, 16-8 each.

Matches #11 & #12: (B Div.) Inconsistently Consistent @ Trips Are For Kids; Put It on Matt's Tab @ Double In, Stumble Out. With Stumble and Kids squaring off in week 14, if the Kids win this get upset help from Matt's Tab, the race for 2nd (and maybe a spot in A) would be on the line. Alas, it's IC, 13-11; and Stumble, 14-10.
